forbidden_top_level_fields.file_edit_plan: Campaign plans may not inline file-level implementation recipes.
forbidden_top_level_fields.patch_plan: Campaign plans may not collapse into patch choreography.
forbidden_top_level_fields.validation_commands: Campaign plans may not inline executable validation selectors or command lists.
forbidden_top_level_fields.shell_commands: Campaign plans may not embed shell-run books as plan truth.
forbidden_top_level_fields.endpoint_diffs: Campaign plans may not smuggle endpoint-level diffs into the planning layer.
forbidden_top_level_fields.commit_message: Campaign plans are pre-PIS durable planning records, not commit-prep notes.
forbidden_top_level_fields.job_payloads: Jobs remain distinct durable objects and may not be embedded inline.

forbidden_phase_fields.file_paths: Phase rows may name outputs but may not list code-edit file paths as execution truth.
forbidden_phase_fields.code_changes: Phase rows may not inline code-change recipes.
forbidden_phase_fields.shell_commands: Phase rows may not embed command lists.
forbidden_phase_fields.validation_commands: Phase rows may not embed validation selectors.
forbidden_phase_fields.endpoint_patch: Phase rows may not collapse into endpoint-patch instructions.
forbidden_phase_fields.commit_message: Phase rows may not pre-author a downstream commit.
forbidden_phase_fields.job_payload: Phase rows may not embed executable job payloads.

intent_sheet: operator goal framing and why the mission matters
non-goals and boundary posture before phased planning exists
broad success shape and acceptable ambiguity at intent time
campaign_plan: phased goal structure with policy-linked constraints
named allowed ambiguities and named pre-PIS resolution requirements
durable provenance hooks and plan-level handoff posture
pis: one bounded implementation or validation slice with concrete proof target
explicit patch/test scope and acceptance surface
child-specific execution order only after campaign-plan compilation
job: router-specific executable payload and runtime lifecycle state
native receipt, run, and retry behavior
